Personal Assistant Job at Softnation Homes Limited




        
    

        
        Softnation Homes Ltd is a forward-thinking real estate development, marketing, and consultancy firm, dedicated to delivering luxury land and home solutions that fuse elegance, exclusivity, and strategic value. We exist to raise the bar in property living, optimizing spaces for discerning cosmopolitans who want more than just shelter, they want prestige, comfort, and a sound investment.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Personal Assistant

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role 
     

            
    




	A real estate marketing firm is looking for a resourceful, execution-focused Personal Assistant who can take instructions and turn them into results — with the flexibility to be available around the clock for time-sensitive tasks.


Responsibilities


	Execute personal and professional errands/plans with minimal supervision
	Manage schedules, travel, and logistics
	Handle time-sensitive requests promptly, including outside standard hours
	Run errands and coordinate with vendors/service providers
	Maintain confidentiality and sound judgment at all times


Requirements


	Minimum 2 years of experience as a Personal Assistant or similar role
	Strong execution skills — able to get things done independently
	Willingness and ability to work flexible/24-7 on-call hours
	Reliable, resourceful, and trustworthy
	Good communication and problem-solving skills
	Experience working with a real estate marketing firm is an advantage
	Must live around Ajah


Salary
N150,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVto: [email protected] using "Personal Assistant Application" as the subject of the email.

Property / Facility Manager Job at Sageto Limited




        
    

        
        Sageto Limited is a Private Limited Liability engineering construction company registered ro carry out building, civil, mechanical, and electrical engineering services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Property / Facility Manager

Job Location: Abuja  (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee the day-to-day management, maintenance, and smooth operation of properties and facilities.
	Coordinate routine and preventive maintenance, repairs, cleaning, security, and other facility services.
	Ensure properties are properly maintained, presentable, safe, and compliant with relevant requirements.
	Identify and source prospective clients/tenants and actively support property occupancy and business development.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
	Conduct property inspections and promptly address maintenance or facility-related concerns.
	Coordinate vendors, contractors, and service providers and monitor their performance.
	Prepare reports on property operations, maintenance activities, and client feedback.
	Monitor facility-related expenses and ensure cost-effective service delivery.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree/HND in Estate Management, Facility Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	3-6 years of relevant experience in property, facility, estate, or operations management.
	Strong client acquisition, communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
	Ability to identify business opportunities and source new clients.
	Good knowledge of property maintenance and facility operations.
	Proactive, organized, and able to work independently.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic reporting tools.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "description": "Domino Stores Limited is a private Nigerian Group of Companies, operating retail, and hospitality and property business.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Internal Control &amp; Compliance Officer

Job Location: Sabo, Yaba - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Function


	The Internal Control &amp; Compliance Officer will be responsible for strengthening the Group&#39;s internal control environment, ensuring compliance with applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, identifying operational and financial risks, conducting control reviews, supporting audit activities, investigating irregularities, and providing recommendations to management for improved efficiency, accountability and risk mitigation.


Key Responsibilities


	Monitor compliance with company policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
	Call over of previous day transactions.

Job Function
